name: Untitled UI (Free Community Edition)
creator: Jordan Hughes / Untitled UI
license_rules: Free to duplicate and use in unlimited personal, client, and commercial projects. Reselling, sublicensing, or redistributing the kit as a competing UI template product is strictly prohibited.
description: The most popular design system in the Figma Community. Contains extensive form components, navigation bars, modals, tables, badges, and dashboard layout components.

name: Google Material 3 Design Kit
creator: Google Material Design
license_rules: Official Google design kit. Completely free for personal and commercial applications. Matches Android 14+ and Google web app standards.
description: Google's official Figma component kit for Material Design 3. Features full dynamic color palettes, elevation layers, typography styles, and native Android/web UI patterns.

name: shadcn/ui Figma Design Kit
creator: Community (Pietro Schirano / Design Systems Hub)
license_rules: Community open-source replica of shadcn/ui components. Free for all commercial and personal workflows.
description: Figma community kit built to mirror shadcn/ui's code components pixel-for-pixel. Eliminates designer-developer friction when translating mockups to React/Tailwind code.

name: Apple Design Resources (iOS & iPadOS)
creator: Apple Inc.
license_rules: Free to use for designing, developing, and prototyping software products for Apple platforms. May not be extracted to create competing non-Apple UI kits.
description: Apple's official Figma UI kit for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS. Essential for mobile developers and responsive web apps targeting Apple design aesthetics.

name: IBM Carbon Design System (Figma)
creator: IBM Design
license_rules: 100% open-source under Apache 2.0. Unrestricted commercial use in enterprise software and public applications.
description: IBM's open-source product design system. Renowned for accessibility, enterprise data tables, structured forms, and rigorous design tokens.

name: Flowbite Free Figma UI Kit
creator: Themesberg
license_rules: Free version on Figma Community. Allowed for commercial and personal project UI designs. Premium blocks sold separately under Flowbite Pro.
description: Official free Figma kit for Flowbite. Maps directly to Tailwind CSS utility classes and Flowbite's interactive web components.
